about_the_game:
A thousand years ago, humanity tore the moon from the sky, sealing it within you and chaining you to the earth. But all chains rust. It's time to spread your wings once more.

Soar between the ruins of a scarred world, exploring floating islands, hidden canyons, and breathtaking monuments, each with unique characters, challenges, and secrets to discover. Using powers divined from the the moon, transform into a shooting star and propel yourself through the air. Peer into the realm of darkness to aid your search for the fallen moon shards.

Your choices shape not only your journey, but the fate of those around you. Will you restore the moon to the sky, or forge a new destiny in a world of eternal light?
